metadata.description: SwarmCloud's own tooling, for operators and agents working in this repository.

plugins.name: sc
plugins.description: SwarmCloud from inside a Claude Code session: read the cluster with the `sc` skill and /sc command, run this session's work out there with the `delegate` skill. `delegate` works through the plugin's own `swarmcloud` MCP server, which fetches the swarm-mcp bridge from this repository at the tag matching the plugin's version and needs only uv. The `sc` skill and /sc run `uv run sc` in the session's directory, so they need a checkout of this repository.
